skill.summary: Security scanner for Python skills before publishing to ClawHub. Use before publishing any skill to check for dangerous imports, hardcoded secrets, unsafe file operations, and dangerous functions like eval/exec/subprocess. Essential for maintaining trust and ensuring published skills are safe for others to install and run.

latestVersion.changelog: Enhanced detection: Now catches file write operations (.write_text, .write_bytes, open for writing) in addition to existing checks. Improved security scanner to detect potential malicious file write patterns before publishing.
